stops.note: from 'sipāh', army; the same word reached English as 'sepoy' through India
cavalrymen paid with 'timar' land grants instead of wages, the backbone of early Ottoman armies
France raised Algerian spahi cavalry regiments from 1834, known for their red cloaks
first used for Ottoman horsemen, later for France's North African cavalry

current_meaning: an Ottoman cavalryman; later a North African cavalryman in the French army
